Title: Public Preview: Azure Firewall Updates - Customer Provided Public IP Support for Secured Virtual Hubs

Body.Content:
Customer Provided Public IP Support for Secured Virtual Hub: Admins can now assign customer-managed public IPs to Secured Virtual Hub firewalls (new deployments only). 

Key benefits: 

  • Full control – Own and manage the lifecycle of your firewall’s public IP. 

  • Enhanced security – Enable DDoS mitigation for better protection. 

  • IP address flexibility – Allocate public IPs from an IP prefix pool. 

Learn more: 

  • About Customer Provided Public IP Support
